shows\n\nChicago crime incidents drawn with a chosen icon set. The three inputs change `prefix` (Font Awesome, Ionicons or Glyphicons), `markerType` (a png pin with a glyph inside, or the bare glyph) and the glyph size (`extraClasses`). Each offence type gets its own glyph, pin colour and glyph colour.\n\n### The SPL\n\n```spl\n| inputlookup chicago-crime.csv\n| eval prefix=$prefix$, markerType=\"$iconOnly$\"\n... (icon1 to icon8: one glyph name per icon set, chosen with case(like(prefix, ...)) - see Open in Search)\n| eval markerColor=case(like(description, \"%SIMPLE%\"), \"red\", ... 1=1, \"blue\"),\nicon=case(...), iconColor=case(...), layerDescription=case(...),\nextraClasses=if(markerType=\"icon\", \"$iconSize$\", \"fa-lg\")\n| eval description = \"\".description.\"\", tooltip=description, clusterGroup=\"default\"\n| table latitude, longitude, description, tooltip, markerColor, icon, clusterGroup, prefix, markerType, iconColor, extraClasses, layerDescription\n```\n\nStudio may show current token values in place of the `$...$` placeholders above.\n\n### How it works\n\n1. `inputlookup` returns one row per incident with `latitude`, `longitude` and `description`.\n2. `eval prefix=$prefix$, markerType=\"$iconOnly$\"` copies two inputs onto every row. The Icon Set input adds the quotes, so `prefix` is a string such as \"fa\".\n3. `icon1` to `icon8` hold glyph names for each set, because a name only works with its own prefix (`gavel` in `fa`, `bicycle` in `ion`, `euro` in `glyphicon`).\n4. `case(like(description, ...))` then picks `markerColor`, `icon`, `iconColor` and `layerDescription` for each offence type, with a catch-all `1=1`.\n5. `extraClasses` takes the Icon Size value only when `markerType` is `icon`; png pins keep `fa-lg`.\n6. `description` is wrapped in HTML bold and copied to `tooltip`; the final `table` keeps only fields Maps+ reads.\n\n### Field formats and rules\n\n| Field | Format | Rule / gotcha |\n|---|---|---|\n| `latitude`, `longitude` | decimal degrees | Exact lowercase names; required. |\n| `markerType` | `png` or `icon` here | Also `svg`, `circle`, `custom`, `milsymbol`; any other value throws `Invalid markerType`. |\n| `markerColor` | png: a named color (red, pink, green, orange, darkred, cadetblue, blue here) | Any name outside Maps+'s fixed list renders a blank marker. |\n| `icon` | glyph name without prefix | `gavel`, not `fa-gavel`; must exist in the set named by `prefix`. |\n| `prefix` | `fa`, `fab`, `ion`, `glyphicon` | Default `fa`. |\n| `iconColor` | any CSS color | Default `white`. |\n| `extraClasses` | CSS classes such as `fa-2x` | Default `fa-lg`. |\n| `clusterGroup` | any string | Rows with different values never cluster together. |\n| `layerDescription` | HTML text | Label in the layer control. |\n| `description`, `tooltip` | HTML | Click popup and hover text; escape event text. |\n\n### Try it\n\n- Set Icon Only to Yes and Icon Size to fa-4x: the pins become bare glyphs.\n- In Open in Search, change `\"red\"` for `%SIMPLE%` in `markerColor` to `\"purple\"` to recolor that pin.\n\n### Studio note\n\nOn Maps+ 4.6.9 and earlier the icon fonts are blocked inside Studio, so glyphs show as empty boxes (pins still render, and `markerType=icon` is not usable). Fixed in unreleased 4.6.10. Studio can double-apply the Icon Set quotes after a hard reload: re-pick the value if the map goes empty.\n" } }, "viz_brands": { "type": "leaflet_maps_app.maps-plus", "title": "Font Awesome Brands", "splunk.markdown", "options": { "markdown": "### What this shows\n\nNine brand icons placed on the map, one marker per row of a lookup. The lookup already has the shape Maps+ wants, so the dashboard needs no SPL beyond reading it.\n\n### The SPL\n\n```spl\n| inputlookup fa-brands.csv\n```\n\n### How it works\n\n1. `inputlookup fa-brands.csv` returns rows with `latitude`, `longitude`, `icon`, `prefix`, `tooltip` and `layerDescription`.\n2. `icon` is the brand name without any prefix (for example `twitter`), and `prefix` is `fab`, the Font Awesome brands set.\n3. `tooltip` is the hover text.\n4. With no `layerGroup`, Maps+ groups markers by icon name, so each brand is its own layer; `layerDescription` is the label shown for it in the layer control.\n5. No `markerType`, so each row is a png pin with the glyph inside. Clustering is off for this panel (`cluster` option `0`).\n\n### Field formats and rules\n\n| Field | Format | Rule / gotcha |\n|---|---|---|\n| `latitude`, `longitude` | decimal degrees | Exact lowercase names; required. |\n| `icon` | name without prefix | `twitter`, not `fa-twitter`. |\n| `prefix` | `fab` for brands | `fa`, `fab`, `ion` or `glyphicon`; default `fa`. |\n| `tooltip` | HTML text | Hover text. |\n| `layerDescription` | HTML text | Layer control label. |\n\n### Try it\n\n- Append `| eval markerType=\"icon\", extraClasses=\"fa-3x\"` to draw bare glyphs instead of pins.\n- Append `| eval iconColor=\"red\"` to recolor the glyphs.\n\n### Studio note\n\nGlyphs inside the pins are blank boxes on Maps+ 4.6.9 and earlier (icon fonts blocked in Studio); fixed in unreleased 4.6.10.\n" } } }, "layout": { "globalInputs": [ "input_prefix", "input_iconOnly", "input_iconSize" ], "tabs": { "items": [ { "label": "New tab", "layoutId": "layout_1" } ] }, "layoutDefinitions": { "layout_1": { "type": "absolute", "options": { "width": 1440, "height": 2548, "display": "auto", "backgroundColor": "#FFFFFF" }, "structure": [ { "item": "viz_icons", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 720, "h": 760 } }, { "item": "md_icons", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 720, "y": 0, "w": 720, "h": 1603 } }, { "item": "viz_brands", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 0, "y": 1603, "w": 720, "h": 760 } }, { "item": "md_brands", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 720, "y": 1603, "w": 720, "h": 945 } } ] } } } }
